convergence.purpose: reduce uncertainty and false positives while enabling bounded program correction
convergence.priority_rule: P0 when the operator can invalidate a current claim, expose false-positive/overfit, detect address/covariance error, or block unsafe automatic correction.
convergence.non_compensation: A PASS on one axis cannot compensate a missing critical gate on another.
